description: Source code defining the PluginBlueprint class and its nested ParsedPluginInfo class, used for processing plugin interface data, notifications, and related metadata.

classes.name: PluginBlueprint
classes.description: Main class representing a plugin blueprint, encapsulating plugin metadata, interface processing, and notification handling.

classes.name: ParsedPluginInfo
classes.description: Nested class within PluginBlueprint responsible for parsing and managing interface-related data, including RPC and notification interfaces.

methods.name: processInterfaces
methods.description: Processes parsed data to extract interface names, notification info, and file mappings.

methods.name: extractRootName
methods.description: Static method to extract the root name from a full interface name.

methods.name: hasNotification
methods.description: Determines if a class data contains notification information.

methods.name: gatherNotificationEntries
methods.description: Collects notification entries from class data based on naming and hierarchy.

methods.name: collectNotificationEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of collected notification entries.

methods.name: isJsonRpcPlugin
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports JSON-RPC based on tags in parsed data.
